2.t: and by the night when it grows still,

3.t: your Lord has not forsaken you [Prophet], nor does He hate you,

4.t: and the future will be better for you than the past;

5.t: your Lord is sure to give you so much that you will be well satisfied.

6.t: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?

7.t: Did He not find you lost and guide you?

8.t: Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient?

9.t: So do not be harsh with the orphan

10.t: and do not chide the one who asks for help;

11.t: talk about the blessings of your Lord.
